# Native remote read and single-root launch contract

These are **synthetic source-shaped fixtures**, not captured PC/LAN responses or platform qualification. They preserve the relevant JSON shapes from installed Pinokio/pinokiod8.2.0 inspected October16. The original26 local pterm captures remain unchanged in the parent directory.

Provenance: canonical dated P0 receipt under _local/pinokio-proof/lan-compat-20261016/mac-p0/P0-CONTRACT.md; extracted archive SHA256 dd07124b5e6f1100a635f0b68024770a42defbd82075dba0b4c1ef67a1d0ae87.

Native owners: server/routes/apps.js (version-independent node-local search/status/log reads), server/lib/app_registry.js (native default and advertised URL shape), server/autolaunch.js540 (candidates), kernel/launch_requirements.js230/262/767 (same REQUIRES key and conditional native preparation).

Official references checked October16: [release8.2.0](https://github.com/pinokiocomputer/pinokio/releases/tag/v8.2.0), [candidate owner](https://github.com/pinokiocomputer/pinokiod/blob/main/server/autolaunch.js), [first-party caller](https://github.com/pinokiocomputer/pinokiod/blob/main/server/views/partials/launch_settings_dependency_script_loader_factory.ejs). Moving main does not replace the installed source snapshot.

The candidates API cannot distinguish a missing ENVIRONMENT from a swallowed read/parse error. Tests must retain native_projection_unattested rather than fabricate complete read authority. These fixtures do not assert complete remote metadata reads. P2b tests exercise a fixed native WebSocket through an in-process fake only; no listener, actual target or native app is started.

Node-local /apps/logs returns source equal to the native log kind, api or shell (server/lib/app_logs.js78/97/111; server/routes/apps.js1071). It does not return the status/search source.local shape. Peer-forwarded log source objects are refused. The tests also consume the existing real local logs-before-run capture to pin that distinction.

P2b selected route: one server-derived installed default script URI and its native query input, with requirements enabled (no skip_requirements, id, method, action, stop or model-selected URI). Pinokio owns recursive sequencing and continuation. Native default/root/candidate/declaration facts are fingerprinted before consent and reread after WS open; no automatic install/default fallback is synthesized. Missing or HTTP defaults and admitted install defaults refuse. Tests cover exact alsoStarts even for conservative declarations outside the effective native default, target/Stop/restore/owner loss before send, shared in-flight observation, unknown-send retention/capacity, and client-only disposal.

Status running_scripts/ready_script correlate the selected script's native HTTP probe. Aggregate app.ready or a stale unrelated URL is insufficient. Even a correlated successful probe is not native isScriptReady and does not establish Batshit-side app reachability; no-HTTP completion remains unknown. Native socket request/close source: installed server/socket.js159–175,279–305; native requirements switch kernel/api/index.js1933; root default kernel/api/index.js1793–1821; native status runtime correlation server/lib/app_registry.js262–325.

The bounded direct WS client uses the existing undici dependency (no install). A dedicated Agent preserves normal TLS, sends no custom credentials, rejects redirects in the library handshake and limits incoming frames. Official [WebSocket documentation](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/blob/main/docs/docs/api/WebSocket.md) checked October16; installed dependency source/types are the actual API authority. No HTTPS proxy has been qualified.

Independent P2b safety repair: native launch.requirements.control blocked/cancelled are retained as visible unknown-with-reason and never described as continuing; terminal errors are rechecked after awaited status before HTTP-ready. Normal running menu defaults can switch to HTTP Open links: preview/no-op is read-only, and exact recorded native root/path-style/script status can reconcile an uncertain issuance without constructing a new command. Native HTTP reachability from another script or changed native folder cannot reconcile it. Joined callers detach on their own Stop/deadline while the original admitted flight remains owned. Fingerprints include stable selected launch intent and observed graph, with candidate membership/install guards revalidated independently; incidental menu/candidate properties and dependency Open defaults do not require reapproval.
